AlternateTargets: the three mysterious gates and three essentials
Senses.Explanation: The three mysteries and three essentials name a Linji-house verbal device that later masters enumerate and test in public interviews. The record supplies a generative formula—one phrase contains three mysterious gates and each gate three essentials—but no stable item-by-item list shared by all witnesses. Linji Yixuan's source formula says that one phrase must contain three mysterious gates and each gate three essentials (一句語須具三玄門，一玄門須具三要); because it does not contain the exact compound, it supports the family rather than the headword count. Fenyang Shanzhao's own record uses the compound both in prose—within one phrase are three mysteries and three essentials, with guest and host plainly distinct (一句中有三玄三要。賓主歷然)—and in verse, where they are hard to distinguish and the meaning is reached by forgetting words. The Eyes of Humans and Gods says that one shout embraces the three mysteries and three essentials (一喝中。體攝三玄三要也). Later public records identify the device with the Linji house, place it beside the four selections, guest and host, illumination and function, or demand it as a live interview question. Tianyin Yuanxiu says, in Linji there are the three mysteries and three essentials, with illumination and function simultaneous (在臨濟則三玄三要，照用同時). Qiran Chaozhi asks which phrase is the three-mysteries-and-three-essentials phrase and elsewhere instructs hearers to remove that device together with the four selections and the shout that divides guest and host. Jie'an Wujin names it among the Linji family's devices. The compound therefore names a Linji-house teaching device that later masters continually enumerate and publicly test; the corpus does not provide a stable item-by-item definition shared by all witnesses.
Senses.Note: Render the graphs literally. Fixed enumerations of the three mystery graphs (玄) appear in Fenyang and later handbooks, not as a stable separate lexical thing. Lists, verses, explanations, and interview questions are different deployments of the same named device, so no second sense was created. Supporting component passages are labelled and excluded from the exact floor.
